scope: Static host-only legal cases under direct settlement or regional jurisdiction
inputs: canonical claimant and worker cohort IDs
explicit host right, eligibility, disposition, rationale and duties
exact scoped authority binding/target and WP-013 resolution
unique positive dated participation claims and complete shared work precedence
procedure: Validate direct jurisdiction and exact policy binding. Retain unresolved authority, rights and missing inputs. Evaluate all dated work through DOM-02. Complete an eligible case only when every named work claim is fully fulfilled; otherwise retain the right and capacity-blocked case. Return host disposition and proposed duties as private hypothetical evidence only.
independent_oracle: Five hours cannot finish two three-hour cases. Case A first completes A and leaves B one hour short; B first reverses the whole-case outcome. Four care hours first leave only one procedural hour, so neither case completes. No capacity erases neither right nor claim.

ports.authority: Shared world jurisdiction and WP-013 policy resolver also used by actual DOM-03
ports.evidence: Detached legal inputs, per-case findings, policy evaluation and complete economy report

owned_state: None; no persisted queue, rights database or separate time ledger
limits: No inferred legal merits, validated rights, fairness or compliance score
No implicit eligibility, cohort disjointness or work precedence
No automatic goods entitlement, enforcement or external rescue
No production content/model activation or accepted revision
No arrival, processing, settlement or enforcement transitions
Interviews, complete source coverage, other counterparts and parent acceptance remain pending
review_route: SV separate author inspection; independent agent review deferred
